messages:
maria ng: quick heads-up — preparing tomorrow's weekly KPI review. dashboards show 420 leads attributed to last week's launch posts, but HubSpot only has 287 with launch campaign utm_source. Can owners check? :eyes:
aj: which dashboard + link?
samir: [dash] https://app.redwood/dashboards/lead-flow?filter=launch-posts — the viz uses first-touch vs HS uses last-touch. that could explain some
chloe: also saw a spike in webinar signups that might be double-counted when they came via launch posts + webinar flow
ben (sales): sales sees about ~260 SFDC leads from that time window, but routing rules may have split some to other campaigns
maria ng: agreed — we need a reconciled number for the review. propose 3 actions: 1) quick SQL check to count distinct emails by utm params 2) confirm dashboard attribution logic 3) confirm routing rules in the time window
samir: i'll run the SQL now — snippet:
```sql
select count(distinct email) as leads, utm_source, utm_medium
from events.leads
where received_at between '2026-03-10' and '2026-03-17'
group by utm_source, utm_medium;
```
aj: i'll validate the dashboard's "first_touch" toggle and update the viz if needed
chloe: i'll segment webinar cohorts vs organic launch-posts and share quick pivot
growth-bot: weekly-kpi-summary: launch_posts: dashboard=420, hubspot=287, sfdc=260, webinar_signups=110
maria ng: thanks all — samir please post the SQL count in this thread; aj & chloe please add tiny notes to the dashboard (footnote + updated filter). meet TOM 9:30 to finalize talking points
ben (sales): +1. can we surface conversion-to-mql % in the dashboard? that's what leadership will ask
maria ng: yes — add conv -> mql as a small line chart. we'll aim to publish the one-pager after the 9:30 huddle :rocket:
